answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational pearl of security, anchoring virtual identities to biometric uniqueness to bridge the canyon between digital agents and physical reality. By requiring localized proof, the system forces attackers to acquire scarce biological data, turning the ocean of potential fake accounts into an economically infeasible venture. This mechanism imposes a high capital cost on sybil actors, as scaling fraudulent identities requires authentic physical presence that remains strictly finite.
